lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Chapter title. Leave a clean beat before story begins.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The passage opened in the middle of the afternoon while they were still arguing about whether to take a paying survey job on the east side.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One moment the wall behind the tanners' drying racks was ordinary brick. The next it had a dark mouth in it, already breathing cooler air. Three notches sat at the base of the left wall—two of theirs from two days earlier, and a third cut deeper, the edges still sharp with fresh stone dust.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg stopped so hard the nearest donkey shied.
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun was already moving toward it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg stepped in front of her. Not aggressive. Just solid.
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: It's three. We don't know who cut the third.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He looked past her into the passage.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The cold air spilling from it carried the familiar smell of damp clay.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: You remember the room that learned your name.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg rested both hands on the butt of his spear.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: Then stop making me say the rest.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: If we'd turned away from the first passage, we'd still think this city was ordinary.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: If we'd walked farther into the basin room, you wouldn't have come back.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She had seen the argument before.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One person believing every answer lived one step farther.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Another believing survival depended on knowing when to stop walking.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek realized they were both right.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: That's exactly why we're not going in.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo had come up on Zeek's left. She studied the notches, then the narrowing edges of the passage, then the way the light from the street already seemed reluctant to enter.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: It's starting to close. Whatever's in there doesn't plan on staying open long.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun's voice stayed level, but the stylus in her hand had gone white at the knuckles.
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: If we walk away every time the city answers, the only record left is the one it keeps. That's how names disappear. That's how my sister disappeared.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: And if we walk in every time it answers, we end up like the pack with the straps cut. I'm not carrying another empty bag back to this fucking room.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The passage breathed once, soft and patient. The third notch looked deeper in the shifting light.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek felt the mark under the linen give a single slow pulse. He ignored it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: You're the one who decides the jobs. So decide.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The street behind them kept up its ordinary noise—drying racks flapping, someone cursing a late delivery, a child crying over nothing important. The four of them stood in the small pocket of quieter air the open passage had made, and for a moment no one added anything else.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek looked at the three notches. At Ninsun's face. At the way BAH-lahg's shoulders had set. At En-HEH-doo already calculating whether the risk had a price worth naming.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: and we change the rules right now. No more following marks we didn't cut. No more open cuts in districts we haven't walked twice. If a passage already has three notches, we leave it. And if we find another pack, we leave the tablet where it is and we walk.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Then BAH-lahg nodded once, short and final.
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: It's refusing to get stupid about it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun stared at the third notch a moment longer. When she finally stepped back, the motion looked like it cost her. She pulled her map free, found the tanners' row, and wrote a single word beside the passage in the same tight hand she used for everything that mattered:

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Written text (ledger/inscription/journal, not in Bel-iddin's hand). Cold, deliberate read.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She stared at the word for several moments.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Written text (ledger/inscription/journal, not in Bel-iddin's hand). Cold, deliberate read.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: You found the scholar's way to lose the argument.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: I'll take the limited version of dead over the ambitious one.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The four of them turned together.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: As though someone on the other side had placed a hand against it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A woman walked past carrying folded leather without looking at it.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: What do we think that was?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Only Zeek looked back one final time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At the base of the wall, where the three notches had been—
